title: Sony Memory Stick Walkman NW-MS7
lede: An early digital music player shaped as a flattened silver capsule, with a translucent blue front and chrome earbuds.
summary: Silver capsule body, translucent blue face, wide techno “MS WALKMAN” lettering, chrome earbuds. Sony, 2000.

source.label: V&A: Sony Memory Stick Walkman NW-MS7, W.665:1 to 14-2001

evidence.note: Inspected the V&A photograph of object W.665:1 to 14-2001 (image 2006AF4293, 1271 × 1600) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Clear: silver metallic plastic, a translucent blue panel, a rounded capsule form, chrome earbuds, and wide rounded techno lettering.

context: The V&A describes a “flattened cylinder form on grey/silver plastic, incorporating a LED display”. The player stored up to 80 minutes of music on a Memory Stick instead of a cassette. [V&A W.665-2001](https://collections.vam.ac.uk/item/O60018/sony-memory-stick-walkman-nw-personal-stereo-sony-corporation/).
observed: The body is a long rounded capsule in pale silver plastic. The ends are rounded and the sides curve.
A translucent royal-blue panel runs down the front. It narrows in the middle and holds the LCD, the name, and a window for the Memory Stick.
“MS WALKMAN” is set in wide, rounded, extended capitals; smaller labels such as “PORTABLE MEMORY STICK PLAYER” are in small spaced capitals.
The earbuds are polished chrome with black rims and show sharp highlight lines.
interpretation: This is the chrome side of Y2K in a product: silver as the base material, one saturated translucent color, and a wide techno wordmark.
The hourglass-shaped blue panel on the capsule reads like a device interface drawn as an object.
borrow: Put a translucent color panel on a silver base, and taper it so the base shows at the edges.
Set a short product name in wide rounded capitals, with small spaced capitals as secondary labels.
Use polished chrome with one hard highlight line for small accessories or icons.
